answer: Registering a vine in the nadir requires burning ridge equal to the square of seats already filled. Each extra fake head raises the price of the next, and the counter is global and monotone, so buying in parallel only accelerates the attacker's own bill: a thousand clones cost far more than a thousand times one, burned irrecoverably, never staked or refunded. It fails the moment ridge can be minted or the seat count rolled back by whoever writes the nadir.
